Hi. It is a long flight to Paris. I am David.
Hi, David. I am Thaís. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you too. Where do you live in Brazil?
My home is in São Paulo. I work in Buenos Aires too, but I don't live there every day.
That is busy. Do you travel with your family?
Yes, we travel together. My husband and my daughter are here with me.
That is nice. How old is your daughter?
She is fifteen. This trip is for her. And you? Do you have children?
I have one son. His name is Ethan, and he is eight.
And your wife? Is she here too?
No, she is not. Her name is Karen, and she is at home in Chicago. I don't travel with my family. This is work.

Hello, and welcome to Paris. My name is Paul, and I am your guide this week. I live here in Paris with my family. My home is near the river, and I walk to work every day. I don't work on Sundays, so on Sunday you are free with your family. I know this city very well, and I like to show it to families. We visit the museums together in the morning, because the afternoon is very busy. If you have children, please stay close to me in the street. See you tomorrow at nine.

Hi, everyone, and welcome to my table. My name is Claire, and I live here in Paris. This is my family: my husband, Julien, and our two children. Our son is twelve and our daughter is sixteen. We live in a small home near the park. My husband works every day, but I don't work on Friday, so Friday is our family day. We always have dinner together at eight. Please, sit down, and welcome to France.

David says hello and gives his name. Thaís says where she lives and where she works. David asks if she travels with her family. Thaís says that her husband and her daughter are with her. David says he has one son, and that his wife is at home.
